info.title: Hotel Platform API
info.description: Staff app API. Money is a string of minor units with a currency; dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`; instants are ISO 8601 UTC. Errors use the `ErrorEnvelope`.

session.name: sid
session.description: Session cookie set by sign-in (httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax).

ErrorEnvelope.description: Every error response. Clients branch on `code`, never on `message`.

Accepted.description: Sent if the account exists and qualifies; never says which.

Me.description: The signed-in user, their session and what they can access.

get.summary: This API description (OpenAPI 3.1)

post.summary: Create an owner account, organisation and first property
post.description: Creates the owner, their organisation (with role templates) and first property in SETUP, then emails a verification link. Answers the same way when the email is already registered, so it never reveals which addresses have accounts.

post.summary: Confirm an email address with the link token
Send a new verification link
Sign in with email or phone and password
post.description: Sets the `sid` cookie. Five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes; while locked, even the right password is refused with the same message. An unverified email gives 403 with `details.reason = EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` (only after a correct password).

post.summary: End the current session
post.description: On a shared device only this session ends and the device waits for the next PIN, except when the manager who opened the device signs out without `keepDevice`: that closes the device and every session on it. "Switch user" sends `keepDevice: true`.

post.summary: Email a password reset link
Set a new password with the link token
post.description: Signs out every session of the user and clears any lockout.

get.summary: The signed-in user
get.description: Also answers before MFA is passed, so the app can show the MFA step.

get.summary: My active sessions and devices

delete.summary: Sign out one of my sessions

post.summary: Pass MFA for this session with an authenticator or recovery code
post.description: Rotates the session cookie. A wrong code counts towards the sign-in lockout (5 failures, 15 minutes). A code is never accepted twice; a recovery code works once.

post.summary: Start turning on MFA: a new secret for the authenticator app
post.description: Returns the secret and an otpauth:// link for the QR code. MFA is on only after /me/mfa/confirm.

post.summary: Finish turning on MFA with a code from the app
post.description: Turns MFA on, passes it for this session (rotating the cookie) and returns 10 single-use recovery codes. They are shown only this once.

put.summary: Set or change my PIN for shared devices
put.description: Needs the current password. A wrong password counts towards the sign-in lockout.

get.summary: Whether this browser is a shared device staff can PIN into

post.summary: Switch user on a shared device with email or phone and PIN
post.description: Needs the device cookie from a manager’s shared-device sign-in. Creates a session under the device session (30-minute idle, ends with the device). Users whose roles require MFA must sign in with their password instead (403, details.reason = MFA_USERS_SIGN_IN_WITH_PASSWORD). Wrong PINs count towards the lockout.

get.summary: The permission catalogue a hotel role can hold
Roles of the organisation

post.summary: Create a role

patch.summary: Edit a role: permissions, limits, MFA (and the name of custom roles)
patch.description: Changes apply to everyone holding the role from their next request; a new MFA requirement from their next sign-in. The Owner role always keeps role.manage, role.assign and user.invite and always requires MFA.

get.summary: Staff with a role in this property

patch.summary: Change a user’s roles here, disable them, or reset their MFA
patch.description: You can only give or take roles whose permissions you hold, only change users who hold no permission you lack, and never yourself. Disabling or resetting MFA signs the user out everywhere. Removing a role ends access through it on the next request.

post.summary: A one-time password reset link to give a user (e.g. phone-only staff)
post.description: Valid 24 hours, single use; using it signs the user out everywhere. Same rules as changing the user. Spec issue 34.

get.summary: Pending invitations for this property (and organisation-wide)

post.summary: Invite someone by email or phone with a role
post.description: Email invitations are emailed. Phone invitations return the one-time link (`link`) for the inviter to share until WhatsApp delivery exists (T-024). Valid 7 days; inviting the same person again replaces the earlier invitation. Organisation-wide invitations need role.manage; the role’s permissions must all be the inviter’s own.

post.summary: Withdraw a pending invitation
What an invitation link is for, before accepting it
Accept an invitation
post.description: New people send their name and a password, which creates their account (the link proves the email or phone). People who already have an account accept while signed in to it.

get.summary: The audit log, newest first
Approval requests at this property, newest first
One approval request

post.summary: Approve and run the action exactly as requested
Reject with a reason

get.summary: The approval policy of every protected action at this property

put.summary: Replace the policies of the listed actions

post.summary: Reserve a file and get a short-lived link to upload it to
post.description: Send the file with `method` to `url`, with exactly the returned `headers`. The file can be downloaded once the scan marks it clean.

get.summary: A link to download a clean file, valid for 5 minutes
The organisation of the current property

patch.summary: Change the organisation name or legal name

get.summary: Properties of the organisation the caller can open

post.summary: Add a property to the organisation (starts in setup)
post.description: The new property starts in SETUP with the organisation country defaults, the department templates and the default approval policies. Organisation-wide roles reach it at once.

schema.description: Reuse the same key when retrying; a different body with a used key is rejected.

parameters.description: Reuse the same key when retrying; a different body with a used key is rejected.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.summary: A property with its settings and setup checklist

patch.summary: Change property details, region, times or payment methods
patch.description: Time zone and base currency are fixed once the property is live (409 STATE_TRANSITION_INVALID).

post.summary: Open the property for bookings once its setup checklist is complete
post.description: Answers 409 STATE_TRANSITION_INVALID with `details.steps` (the required steps still to do) when the checklist is not ready, or `details.status` when the property is not in SETUP.

get.summary: Room types of the property, active and inactive

post.summary: Add a room type

patch.summary: Change a room type, or deactivate it once it has no active rooms

get.summary: Rooms of the property with their current and future blocks

post.summary: Add a room

patch.summary: Change a room: number, type, floor, features, connecting room, active

post.summary: Put a room out of order or out of service for a date range
post.description: Out of order removes the room from availability; out of service keeps it counted but not assignable (PRD M2 rule 2). A block starting today sets the housekeeping status at once.

post.summary: End a block early or cancel a future one

get.summary: Revenue codes of the property

post.summary: Add a revenue code

patch.summary: Rename a revenue code, change its taxes, or deactivate it

get.summary: Tax rules with their versions, and whether the rates were confirmed

post.summary: Add a tax or service charge with its first version
Change a tax from a date: new rate, basis, order or inclusiveness
post.description: The version in force ends the day before. Earlier versions never change, so lines already posted keep their taxes (PRD M4 rule 1). A rate of 0 ends a tax.

post.summary: Record that the tax rules and rates were checked (setup checklist)

get.summary: Cancellation policies of the property

post.summary: Add a cancellation policy

get.summary: Rate plans of the property with their package components

post.summary: Add a rate plan: BAR, derived, package or day-use

patch.summary: Change a rate plan; existing reservations keep their prices

get.summary: Prices and restrictions of one plan by room type and date

put.summary: Bulk edit prices and restrictions by date range, weekday and room type
put.description: Only the fields in `set` change. Days whose values change get a new rule version; quotes and reservations made earlier keep theirs.

get.summary: Package plans and their components

post.summary: Set the components of a package plan (replaces the list)
Check an uploaded spreadsheet; nothing is written until it is applied
post.description: Answers 409 FILE_NOT_READY while the file is still being scanned. Every invalid row is listed; a file with errors cannot be applied.

get.summary: An import and its report

post.summary: Write a checked import (all rows or none)
post.description: Answers 409 STATE_TRANSITION_INVALID when the import had errors, was already applied, or no longer fits what is in the property (details.errors).

get.summary: Rooms left per room type and date

put.summary: Set how many rooms may be sold above capacity (default 0)
put.description: Lowering the limit below what is already sold answers 409 STATE_TRANSITION_INVALID with the dates.

get.summary: Room types that fit the guests, rooms left, and the price per rate plan
get.description: Overnight stays from today, at most 60 nights. Day-use plans are quoted with day-use bookings (T-052).

post.summary: Price a stay on one rate plan; the quote holds for 30 minutes
post.description: Answers 422 RESTRICTION_VIOLATED with details.violations (min/max stay, closed to arrival or departure, stop-sell, no price), 409 BOOKING_CONFLICT with details.dates when no room of the type is left, and 409 STATE_TRANSITION_INVALID when the property has no room revenue code yet.
